notes.title: Update 1.1 ‘Healing Mode’
notes.content:
Based on your feedback from the first month since launch, we’ve implemented our first major update.

[b]Major Changes:[/b]
1. Healing Mode Added - Instead of adjusting difficulty levels, you can now enable Healing Mode from the Options menu in the main menu. In Healing Mode, stamina is unlimited, and the feather UI is removed.
2. Additional Settings - You can now adjust mouse sensitivity and screen brightness in both the main menu and the pause menu.

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
- Eased the Jump+Boost tutorial and removed the guide.
- Added UI sound effects to the pause menu.
- The selected language is now retained in the options menu.
- Reduced BGM volume in the Upstream(snowy terrain).
- Fixed various minor potential bug issues.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[b]Changes : [/b]
- Increased overall sound volume.
- Fixed an issue where the selected language would not be retained after restarting the game.
- The "Game Saved" UI now appears at save points.
- Added small whirlwinds in the early upstream section for smoother gameplay.
- Reduced the flow speed in the late upstream section by approximately 8%.
(We found that excessive flow speed was affecting some players depending on their play environment. We adjusted the related coefficients to prevent this from impacting the game difficulty for those players.)

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
[b]Changes : [/b]
- Reduced the difficulty of the Jump+Boost tutorial.
- Reduced the difficulty of the Cave section.
(Increased rock spawn cooldown from 5 seconds to 5.5 seconds.)
- Fixed potential bug issues in the Mushroom section.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[b]Changes : [/b]
- Added Guide Text
- Adjusted Obstacle Difficulty *
--------------------------------------------

* Additional Details on Difficulty Adjustments (24.07.03)

1. Reduced the hitbox of the large whirlwinds in the upper stream by approximately 9%.
2. Adjusted the intervals between the large whirlwinds in the upper stream.
3. Fixed a bug affecting stamina regeneration(stamina was recovering too quickly depending on the user's system specifications.)

No other adjustments have been made to stamina, jumping & boosting ability, or water speed.
